apps.name: K3 Browser
apps.subtitle: Adaptive native operator browser
apps.localizedDescription: Native SwiftUI + WKWebView operator browser for iPhone. v0.6 introduces the K3 adaptive native UI: quiet browser rail, page-resizing Agent Shelf, persisted draggable Agent Ball, blocking approval review, hierarchical Mission Control, and accessibility-aware presentation routing—while preserving the verified run, navigation, redaction, persistence, and Engagement Authority foundations.
apps.versionDescription: Adaptive Native UI: page-first browser rail, one command composer, bottom Agent Shelf, movable Agent Ball, scrollable authority review with pinned decisions, single Mission/Share presentation router, Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, Reduce Motion, and deterministic UI architecture gates.
